operations.description:
Endpoint for an end-user client to search similarity by song identifier.

If you want to run the /similarity/by_song operation, you can do so via an HTTP GET command to the following URL:

```
https://searchly.asuarez.dev/api/v1/similarity/by_song
```
operations.summary: API endpoint to search similarity using a song identifier
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] src searchly controllers similarity by song [PATH] similarity by song [PARAMS] id song [SCHEMA] response similarity

operations.description:
Endpoint for an end-user client to search songs from the database given a String query.

If you want to run the /song/search operation, you can do so via an HTTP GET command to the following URL:

```
https://searchly.asuarez.dev/api/v1/song/search
```
operations.summary: API endpoint to search songs from the database given a query
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] src searchly controllers song search [PATH] song search [PARAMS] query [SCHEMA] response song

```

```
operations.summary: API endpoint to search similarity using content
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] src searchly controllers similarity by content [PATH] similarity by content [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] response similarity
